title: Control: valid suppressed type with int keys should be unaffected and use the dynamic resolver
why: Shows that a valid suppressed type yields the same model, no diagnostics and the same dynamic round-trip before and after, with no generated formatter.

title: Suppressed type with a public member lacking [Key] (the issue's missing-diagnostic case, MsgPack004)
why: Shows whether MsgPack004 appears in diagnostics for a suppressed type after the change and not before, and whether the build fails.

title: Suppressed type with two properties sharing [Key(0)] (duplicate key, MsgPack005)
why: Shows the model step throwing ArgumentException on the duplicate key before the change, and MsgPack005 reported with the duplicate skipped after it.

title: Normal generated type with duplicate string keys on public fields (field loop)
why: Reaches the duplicate string-key guard in the field loop on a non-suppressed type, showing model and generated output when the second member is dropped.

title: Properties with an int key followed by a string key (mixed kinds, MsgPack005)
why: Shows the new `continue` on mixed key kinds, so the model and generated code drop B after the change while the diagnostic is still reported.

title: Public fields with a string key first, then an int key (field loop, opposite order)
why: Reaches the mixed-key `continue` in the field loop with the reverse key order, which the author's tests do not cover.
